subject: EoQ assessment & narrative handoff — scoring reconciliation and executive brief draft
body:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: EoQ assessment & narrative handoff — scoring reconciliation and executive brief draft

Team,

Thanks for getting your preliminary inputs into the shared scoring sheet. I pulled a quick pass and there are a few reconcile items that should land before I hand the brief to Execs on Monday. High-level asks:

- Reconcile any score deltas > 1 point by EOD Friday (28 Feb). Put a one-line justification in the "reason" column in the matrix.
- Upload evidence (screenshots, metric queries, product notes) to the evidence_rollup.zip link in the Drive folder and add filenames to the matrix.
- If you want a narrative tweak, add a short paragraph to the Notion draft under your objective.

Key disagreements I flagged:
1) Objective: Platform latency — Laura scored 3 -> Karthik scored 4 (disagree reason pending).
2) Objective: Early access revenue — split on whether to count partner pilot as closed-won (affects 0.5 of target).
3) Risk signal for Dedicated onboarding — need a short mitigation line for Exec pack.

Attachments: eoq_scoring_matrix.xlsx (master), qbr_brief_draft.md (working draft), evidence_rollup.zip (placeholder). See Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3eoq-scoring

Proposed timeline:
- Fri 28 Feb 12:00 pm PT: final scores locked
- Fri 28 Feb 3:00 pm PT: consolidated narrative to leadership deck owner (Jonas)
- Mon 2 Mar: Exec packet distributed for review

Action owners: please reply with one-line confirmation and any objections.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Product & Platform
Redwood Inference

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EoQ assessment & narrative handoff — scoring reconciliation and executive brief draft

Vivek —

Confirming I'll reconcile the Platform latency justification by EOD Fri. Quick context: my 3 was driven by a 95th-percentile tail still missing our SLO for the EU region (see note A in matrix). Karthik's 4 looks to be based on host-level improvements that reduced median latency; we should surface both in the narrative (median improvement vs tail risk).

Updated asks from me:
- Karthik: can you add the percentile query (timestamped) to evidence_rollup.zip so we can justify the 4 vs 3 split?
- Jonas: prefer keeping the pilot as "partial credit" in revenue until we get legal confirmation on the invoice cadence — I put a comment in the sheet.

I'll also add a 2-sentence mitigation (circuit-breaker and regional autoscale plan) for the Dedicated onboarding risk.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Quick reply — I updated the matrix with an explicit scoring rubric row (I added a helper column that lists evidence type required for a +1 bump). Summary:

- Platform latency: I'm OK moving to 3 if we surface tail-risk clearly. I'll attach the p95/p99 queries and a short chart to evidence_rollup.zip (file: latency_percentiles_202602).
- Early access revenue: recommend we report as "0.6 of target" (transparency is better than rounding up). I added a short line explaining partner invoicing timing — should be sufficient for Execs.
- Dedicated onboarding: added mitigation text about staged rollouts + pre-prod validation gate (see matrix column).

I'll sync with Legal on partner invoicing language and cc Laura.

-Karthik

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Final stitch: EoQ scores locked + next steps for Exec brief

Great work, team —

I reviewed the updated matrix and evidence pack. Summary of final decisions (I applied these to the master matrix):
- Platform latency: final score = 3. Rationale: median improved significantly; p95/p99 still show regional tail risk. We will call this out in the narrative and include the latency_percentiles_202602.png figure.
- Early access revenue: final credit = 0.6 of target (transparent fractional disclosure). Legal confirms partner invoicing cadence; Jonas, you'll get the short note for the slides.
- Dedicated onboarding: mitigation included; we will call out the staged rollout and pre-prod gate as the primary risk control.

Deliverables & owners: 
- Jonas: consolidate these lines into the QBR executive brief and own the slide pack. Use the QBR draft at Notion: https://notion.so/redwood/eoq-narrative-draft
- Marissa: create a short appendix folder with the raw queries & artifacts for any Executive or Legal follow-up (evidence_rollup.zip already started).
- Laura & Karthik: please confirm the final one-line justifications in the matrix (I made minor copy edits).

I'll hand the packet to Execs at 10:00 am PT on Mon, 2 Mar. If there are unresolved items flag them now. Otherwise I'll assume consensus and proceed.

Thanks again — nice, crisp work getting this across the line.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Product & Platform
Redwood Inference
